name: firefox-container-toolbox
description: Name-based container management with STG integration and Google Drive sync

scripts.dev: bun run build && concurrently --kill-others "bun run watch" "bun run open:firefox"
scripts.build: bun run build:res && bun run build:js
scripts.check: bun run build && bun run check:format && bun run check:type && bun run check:lint
scripts.check:format: bun run check:format:res && bun run check:format:js
scripts.format: bun run format:res && bun run format:js
